**Finalizing Q&A response**

rounds.response:
Q: When can we extend a CoreSupport trial? A: The standard CoreSupport trial is 14 days; agents may approve a one‑time extension of up to 7 additional days per account when the account meets the criteria in the KB article "Trial extensions – CoreSupport."  
Key conditions/limits: request must be submitted while the trial is still active, the account must not have already received an extension, the reason should be a legitimate evaluation/technical/procurement delay, and the account must be in good standing — see the KB for the full checklist.  
Escalate when a customer requests more than 7 extra days, has prior extensions, there are signs of abuse or entitlement/billing issues, or the request arrives after the trial has expired (escalate to your team lead/operations as per the escalation matrix).
